Ivnytsya Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zhytomyr Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. According to his birth certificate, Ivnytsya is the birthplace of Hayim Nahman Bialik (1873–1934) — widely regarded as Israel's national poet and one of the most influential figures in the modern Hebrew literary renaissance — although he actually spent his earliest years in the nearby village of Hrada. Ivnytsya's Jewish community numbered 88 as early as 1765 and grew to 1,060 by 1847, though it had declined to 607 (20 percent of the town) by 1897. A new ohel has been built here over the grave of R. Zeev Wolf.
